description: Runtime clients and execution helpers shared by Clash product surfaces.

modules.src/browser.ts: Browser/Worker exports; never import filesystem, daemon discovery, or process helpers here.
modules.src/project-host-http.ts: Single HTTP transport for existing project Host commands. Browser callers inject their runtime request; Node callers supply the discovered endpoint.
modules.src/project-host-client.ts: Node workspace-marker and Host endpoint resolution, reusing project-host-http transport.
modules.src/timeline-client.ts: Native Timeline Host projection client. Keep the returned observation with each draft; never rotate an old draft's CAS evidence after a background refresh.
modules.src/generator-client.ts: Generic Generator/Revision/Action Run/Output Commit HTTP client.
modules.src/document-client.ts: Platform-neutral native Document HTTP client for kinds/heads/history/exact bodies, create/advance/copy and attachments. Internal observations travel in request headers; public envelope sanitation preserves user body fields. CLI and MCP reuse this transport, without Node storage or manifest authority.
modules.src/logging.ts: Browser-safe versioned diagnostics, structured Error context, bounded sanitization and duplicate summaries. No filesystem or Node imports.
modules.src/observability.ts: Node JSONL sinks and stdio capture; bounded rotation, process run identity, console severity, line framing and startup-only forwarding.
modules.src/log-reader.ts: Read-only local diagnostic query across desktop and Host rotations; legacy compatibility, event summaries and original file/line locations.
modules.src/project-status.ts: Shared Project storage/recovery diagnostics and cloud gates. Readiness requires an exact Project/local-replica admission marked ready by the Host synchronizer; global transport capability flags cannot grant readiness. Raw modes remain conservative recovery hints.
modules.src/project-cloud-sync.ts: Platform-neutral phased Project synchronization with monotonic admission-version CAS. New writes/revocation cancel stale completion; a ready record is rechecked on reconciliation. Exposed via the narrow project-cloud-sync subpath.
modules.src/minimax-executor.ts: Portable MiniMax submit/poll execution, shared by executable plugin and hosted adapter through a narrow subpath. No Node Buffer or credentials persistence. Provider failures come from action-sdk/executable-failure; the SDK Node root is not a portable dependency.
modules.src/gemini-omni.ts: Google Interactions and Files one-request primitives; pending file processing returns control to the durable owner.
modules.src/provider-browser-boundary.test.ts: Bundles portable Provider sources and the Action SDK executable-failure subpath for browser, executes HTTP failure classification without Node globals, and verifies narrow/root class identity and published subpath resolution.
